[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Common Divisors** [CF 1203C · Common Divisors](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1203/C){rating="1300"}

$x$ divides every $a_i$ exactly when $x$ divides $g = \gcd(a_1, \dots, a_n)$. So the answer is the number of divisors of $g$, and $g \le 10^{12}$ needs only a loop to $\sqrt g \le 10^6$.

[Solved in full in @sec-cx-p2-common-divisors.]{.card-link}
